changes: Appendix B separates Rust stable 1.96.1 verified 2026-07-02 from Slint 1.17.1 selected/currentness decision 2026-07-07.
Appendix B requires runtime implementation to reverify official releases before coding/build work.
Appendix B and F3-030 forbid React, Tauri, DOM-rendered product UI, and HTML/CSS/JS product shells.
F3-030 allows only minimal HTML/canvas bootstrap and generated/minimal JavaScript glue for Slint/WASM web while native desktop remains Rust plus Slint .slint markup.
F3-030 and F3-417 surface validate-gui-asset-policy as a validation surface.
ATS validation surfaces include python3 scripts/pm-plans-verify.py validate-gui-asset-policy.
Default roots cover ui, src, app, apps, crates, frontend, web, wasm, native, assets, resources, tests, fixtures, and snapshots.
The default command and validate subcommand alias both execute the same policy.

The policy detects emoji, Extended_Pictographic-style characters, Dingbat-style symbols, arrow/symbol pseudo-icons, remote/CDN icon assets, SVG assets without manifest entries, unresolved icon_id references, and unlabeled icon-only controls.
The policy preserves valid local SVG namespace URLs so ordinary SVG markup is not treated as remote CDN usage.
No GUI source keeps status not_applicable with exit 0.
Treats raw pm-gui-asset-policy statuses pass and not_applicable as verifier pass states.
